M1: Areal weighting of StatBank parish counts to hex (Goodchild & Lam 1980).
M2: Binary dasymetric: equal parish pop per residential BBR building (Eicher & Brewer 2001).
M3: Floor-area weighted dasymetric using BYG_BOLIG_ within parish (Mennis 2003).
M4: DST 1 km class midpoints scaled to KOMM_TOT, areal to hex (previous v1 approach).
M5: Hybrid: DST cell totals refined by BBR bolig weights inside each 1 km cell.
M6: Postcode (POSTNR1) totals + age bands redistributed by BYG_BOLIG_.
